Trust decision: Watch-create authorization calls `authStore.IsRangePermitted` (watch.go:296 via :246), which treats `len(rangeEnd)==0` as an exact-key point check (range_perm_cache.go:124), and the handler had already rewritten the open-ended 0x00 sentinel to `[]byte{}` (watch.go:270-278).
pattern_fit: `injection_only` — the published fix is a single 9-line move in one function; no O2 site and no uncovered watch route (the gRPC proxy has its own Range-probe check and is not vulnerable), so sibling tasks would have to be injected.
Strongest lever: `O5`/`j_overbroad_breaks_legit` — mvcc needs the `[]byte{}` form for `WithFromKey` (watcher_group.go:169,175), so the tempting "delete the rewrite" or "treat empty rangeEnd as open-ended" fixes break legitimate watches or every point read.
Biggest red flag: `regression_tests_in_pinned_commit` — the pinned tree already contains the failing e2e reproducer `TestWatchWithLowPermissionUser` (tests/e2e/watch_test.go:568-641), whose comment states the root cause verbatim; `single_site` also applies.
